review.name: Solar Stag
findings: Original twelve source face/body slices and all 216 actual technique frames inspected: muzzle collapses into scarf and hooves slide. Correct 90-degree anatomical frame used for four fitted legs and a fitted neck/head pair. All original 21 bone frames, inverse binds, sculpture, textures and legacy curves retained. Five fitted gait clips, three coordinated actions, and 26 retargeted neck/head tracks; three-hoof support during the foreleg attack and four during casting/recoil. Candidate V3 all twelve raw slices and all 216 actual technique frames inspected and pass. 1913 frozen-face poses plus 468 blends and 1591 full-geometry poses pass. Maximum supporting sole drift below 0.000062 across 481 samples per action. Separate final rebuilt battle and transition repeat review pending.

Final second pass actually inspected all 24 source/battle raw face/body slices, all 32 production transition slices at low/medium, 24 advancing companion idle frames, all 216 native actual equipped-technique frames in twelve lossless strips, and sixteen atlas cells. All pass. Source and battle each pass 1591 full-geometry poses and 468 independent face blends. Original sculpt, UVs, textures, all original bone frames/inverses retained. Complete-face binding repair plus four fitted limb chains, fitted neck/head pivots with 26 retargeted tracks, five gait passes and three coordinated actions. Fourteen regression/animation-bank tests and production build pass. Whole-roster/main/live verification still pending.

Complete muzzle, chin, antlers and ears remain stable; fitted neck, shoulder and hip joins stay connected and scarf and short tail remain continuous. One forehoof lifts through its fitted chain during strikes while the three other hooves support. Cast and recoil retain all four support paws.
